A1.justification: Both complete 12-page PDFs describe the same SPD research. The main text, equations, figures, tables, and supplementary Sections 8–10 are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original attribute-probing experiments, downstream classification/retrieval/generation evaluations, ablations, and supplementary generation examples and runtime measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains these original SPD experiments and supplementary analyses, including the numerical comparisons in Tables 1–9.

M1.justification: The INLP procedure, subspace projection, and neutral-mean reinjection remain unchanged in Equations 1–7. Limited projection depth was already used in v1; the new qualifications describe its limitations without changing the algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions use FairFace diagnostics, FACET classification, Flickr30K retrieval, and Bias-in-Bios occupation prompts for generation. The gender-specific and gender-neutral scenarios and supplementary examples are retained.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the unmodified backbone, DeAR, CLIP-clip, Prompt-D, and SFID. The changed CLIP-clip citation does not change its described procedure or participation in Tables 4–5.

E3.justification: The backbones, preprocessing, sample counts, downstream r=5 setting, and metric formulas are retained. Section 5.2.1 corrects the description of DeltaDP from recall to prediction-rate disparity, matching the unchanged Equation 8.

E4.justification: The attribute-overlap and residual-signal diagnostics, projection-depth studies, reinjection ablation, and threshold sensitivity analysis are retained. Supplementary Figure 2 and Table 8 contain the same qualitative examples and retrieval-depth results.

E5.justification: Both versions specify ten independent runs for retrieval and generation, 1000 bootstrap samples for classification, and standard-deviation reporting. The changed standard-deviation value in Table 4 does not establish a change in reporting practice or estimation procedure.

E6.justification: In Table 4, SPD with CLIP ViT-B/32 changes from Skew@100 0.0699±0.0866 to 0.0699±0.0566. The mean and ranking remain unchanged. All other numerical entries in Tables 1–9 and the supplementary generated examples are retained.

T1.justification: Sections 4.2–4.3 qualify the asserted linear-unrecoverability guarantee: v2 conditions it on running INLP until a probe reaches chance and explicitly allows residual linear signal at finite r. This revises the stated theoretical property, while the equations remain unchanged and no proof is added.

C1.justification: The conclusion narrows complete linear-bias removal and broad generalization claims to controllable attribute-direction removal with a fairness–utility tradeoff on evaluated tasks. The central SPD contribution remains, and the abstract retains its entire-subspace-removal and 18.5% improvement claims.

C2.justification: Sections 3.4–3.5 soften categorical conclusions about SFID's failure. Sections 4.1–4.3 explicitly connect finite projection depth to residual signal and collateral utility loss, extending the tradeoff already discussed in v1. Section 6.2 replaces demonstrated cross-distribution invariance with evidence suggesting more stable behavior and partial mitigation.

D1.justification: Section 3.2 newly identifies m=100 as the official SFID repository default. Supplementary Table 9 corrects the count of four from GPU cores to GPUs, clarifying hardware reporting without establishing a hardware change. Runtime values and the linked code repository remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds background references including LightFair, medical segmentation with adversarial prompt tuning, and Lian et al.'s closed-form debiasing work. The SFID-centered positioning remains. Section 5.2 also changes CLIP-clip's attribution from Luo et al.'s FairCLIP to Wang et al.'s image-search paper.

P1.justification: Localized rewrites clarify terminology, qualifications, and the conclusion, while the section sequence remains intact. v2 also adds a corresponding-author footnote and acknowledgement, revises bibliographic text, and makes small grammatical and cross-reference corrections.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is reduced in display size, Tables 3–4 receive clearer captions, and spacing and text flow change. Both figures and all nine tables are retained with the same overall structures; supplementary Figure 2 uses identical images.

improvement.justification: The qualifications in Sections 4.1–4.3 and the conclusion better align the removal claims with Table 3's retained evidence of residual signal and collateral losses. The corrected DeltaDP explanation and baseline attribution improve precision. The gain is limited because the abstract still asserts removal of the entire linearly decodable bias subspace despite the new finite-depth qualifications.
